intent: xfce4-notifyd starts only once X answers, so a night-lockdown X restart no longer exhausts its start limit and leaves notify-send with NameHasNoOwner (2026-11-18).
scope: Non-goal: no change to what notifyd shows or to the notification senders
changes: wait_for_x.sh: polls up to 15 s for the display before notifyd execs
drop-in wait-for-x.conf: runs wait_for_x.sh as ExecStartPre and drops the start limit; install.sh copies it to ~/.config/systemd/user/
i3 config: refreshes the D-Bus/systemd activation environment on start
check_notifyd_survives_x_restart.sh: sandboxed repro that brings X up late and sends a notification

verification.evidence: OK: notify-send succeeded while X came up late (exit 0)

risks: A running user manager needs daemon-reload to see the drop-in; install.sh runs it
If X never comes up the unit fails after 15 s instead of looping
rollback: git revert the commit and delete ~/.config/systemd/user/xfce4-notifyd.service.d/wait-for-x.conf, then systemctl --user daemon-reload
